key_grammar.source_sentence: When Olmsted was young, he often went on trips to the countryside with his father, who loved scenery.

explanation.text: 콤마 뒤의 who/which는 앞의 명사(선행사)를 '추가로 설명'하는 계속적 용법이다.
'접속사+대명사'로 풀 수 있어 , who loved scenery = and he(=his father) loved scenery 로 해석된다.
콤마가 없으면 선행사를 한정(제한적)하지만, 콤마가 있으면 부가 설명(계속적)이 된다.
계속적 용법에는 that을 쓸 수 없고, 사람 선행사에는 who, 사물에는 which를 쓴다.
선행사 his father(사람)를 콤마+who로 이어 '풍경을 사랑한 아버지'라는 정보를 덧붙인다.

key_grammar.example_analysis: 선행사 his father를 콤마+who로 계속적으로 부연 설명한다(= and he loved scenery).

drills.question: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 적절하지 않은 것은?
drills.sentence: At age 14, he [[1|was preparing]] [[2|himself]] [[3|to study]] at Yale College, but he could not enter [[4|due to]] a severe sumac poisoning [[5|what]] damaged his eyesight.
drills.fix: 선행사 a severe sumac poisoning가 있으므로 what이 아니라 주격 관계대명사 that(또는 which)이 맞다.

drills.question: 각 네모 안에서 어법에 맞는 것을 고르시오.
drills.sentence: When Olmsted was young, he often [[went/goes]] on trips to the countryside with his father, [[who/which]] [[loved/loving]] scenery.
drills.fix: 과거 시점이므로 went, 사람 선행사 his father의 계속적 용법이므로 who, 관계절의 정동사이므로 loved가 옳다.

drills.question: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
options: Frederick Law Olmsted, known as the father of American landscape architecture, was born in 1822.
Instead of attending a college, he gained experience working as a clerk, a sailor, and a farmer.
During the Civil War, Olmsted served as General Secretary of the United States Sanitary Commission.
When Olmsted was young, he often went on trips to the countryside with his father, which loved scenery.
Although he passed away in 1903, his sons and successors continued his design philosophy.
drills.answer: When Olmsted was young, he often went on trips to the countryside with his father, which loved scenery.
drills.fix: 선행사 his father는 사람이므로 which를 계속적 용법의 who로 고쳐야 한다.

drills.question: 그는 자신의 삼촌과 함께 여행을 갔는데, 그 삼촌은 예술을 사랑했다.
drills.answer: He went on a trip with his uncle, who loved art.

drills.question: Olmsted가 어렸을 때, 그는 풍경을 사랑한 아버지와 함께 종종 시골로 여행을 갔다.
drills.answer: When Olmsted was young, he often went on trips to the countryside with his father, who loved scenery.
